actions.add_note_to_collection.descripti: Add an existing note to an existing collection.
actions.add_note_to_collection.props.col: The collection to add the note to.
actions.add_note_to_collection.props.not: The ID of the note to add. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.create_collection.description: Create a new collection to group notes.
actions.create_mem.description: Send raw content to Mem so it can process and file it for you. Returns only a request ID; the note appears in Mem a few seconds later.
actions.create_mem.props.context.descrip: Additional background that relates this content to your existing knowledge.
actions.create_mem.props.input.descripti: Raw content to remember, such as HTML, an email, a transcript or a simple note.
actions.create_mem.props.instructions.de: Optional guidance on how Mem should process or remember this content.
actions.create_mem.props.timestamp.descr: When the content was captured. Defaults to now.
actions.create_note.description: Create a Markdown note in Mem, optionally adding it to existing collections.
actions.create_note.props.add_to_collect: Existing collection IDs or exact collection titles. Titles that match no collection are ignored; collections are not created.
actions.create_note.props.content.descri: Markdown content (up to 200,000 characters). The first line becomes the note title.
actions.create_note.props.created_at.des: Optional creation timestamp for the note. Defaults to now.
actions.create_note.props.id.description: Optional UUID for the new note. Mem returns a 409 conflict if a note with this ID already exists.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_collection.description: Permanently delete a collection. Its notes are not deleted.
actions.delete_note.description: Permanently delete a note. It cannot be restored; use Trash Note for a recoverable removal.
actions.delete_note.props.note_id.descri: The ID of the note to delete permanently. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.find_related_notes.description: Find notes semantically related to a given note.
actions.find_related_notes.props.limit.d: Maximum related notes to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.
actions.find_related_notes.props.note_id: The ID of the source note. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.get_collection.description: Get the details of a collection.
actions.get_note.description: Get the full content and details of a note by ID.
actions.get_note.props.note_id.descripti: The ID of the note to read. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.list_collections.description: List collections in chronological order, with optional date filters.
actions.list_collections.props.created_a: Only include items created at or after this time (inclusive).
actions.list_collections.props.created_b: Only include items created at or before this time (inclusive).
actions.list_collections.props.limit.des: Collections per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.
Which timestamp to sort by. Defaults to Updated At.
actions.list_collections.props.page.desc: The next_page value from a previous call.
actions.list_collections.props.updated_a: Only include items updated at or after this time (inclusive).
actions.list_collections.props.updated_b: Only include items updated at or before this time (inclusive).
actions.list_notes.description: List notes in chronological order, with optional collection, date and content filters.
actions.list_notes.props.collection_id.d: Only list notes in this collection.
Pick Yes to return only notes with files. Leave empty to include all notes.
actions.list_notes.props.contains_images: Pick Yes to return only notes with images. Leave empty to include all notes.
actions.list_notes.props.contains_open_t: Pick Yes to return only notes with open tasks. Leave empty to include all notes.
Pick Yes to return only notes with any tasks. Leave empty to include all notes.
actions.list_notes.props.created_after.d: Only include items created at or after this time (inclusive).
Only include items created at or before this time (inclusive).
actions.list_notes.props.include_note_co: Return the full Markdown content of each note.
actions.list_notes.props.limit.descripti: Notes per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.
actions.list_notes.props.order_by.descri: Which timestamp to sort by. Defaults to Updated At.
actions.list_notes.props.page.descriptio: The next_page value from a previous call.
actions.list_notes.props.updated_after.d: Only include items updated at or after this time (inclusive).
Only include items updated at or before this time (inclusive).
actions.move_note.description: Move a note from one collection to another.
actions.move_note.props.note_id.descript: The ID of the note to move. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.move_note.props.source_collectio: The collection that currently contains the note.
actions.move_note.props.target_collectio: The collection to move the note to.
actions.remove_note_from_collection.desc: Remove a note from a collection. Both the note and the collection are kept.
actions.remove_note_from_collection.prop: The collection to remove the note from.
The ID of the note to remove. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.restore_note.description: Bring a note back from the trash.
actions.restore_note.props.note_id.descr: The ID of the trashed note to restore. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.search_collections.description: Search collections by text, ranked by relevance.
actions.search_collections.props.created: Only include items created at or after this time (inclusive).
Only include items created at or before this time (inclusive).
actions.search_collections.props.query.d: Free-text query. Leave empty to match all collections.
actions.search_collections.props.updated: Only include items updated at or after this time (inclusive).
Only include items updated at or before this time (inclusive).
actions.search_notes.description: Search notes by text, ranked by relevance, with optional filters.
actions.search_notes.props.collection_id: Only return notes in any of these collections.
actions.search_notes.props.contains_file: Pick Yes to return only notes with files. Leave empty to include all notes.
actions.search_notes.props.contains_imag: Pick Yes to return only notes with images. Leave empty to include all notes.
actions.search_notes.props.contains_open: Pick Yes to return only notes with open tasks. Leave empty to include all notes.
actions.search_notes.props.contains_task: Pick Yes to return only notes with any tasks. Leave empty to include all notes.
actions.search_notes.props.created_after: Only include items created at or after this time (inclusive).
actions.search_notes.props.created_befor: Only include items created at or before this time (inclusive).
actions.search_notes.props.include_note_: Return the full Markdown content of each note.
actions.search_notes.props.limit.descrip: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.
actions.search_notes.props.offset.descri: Number of results to skip (zero-based). Requires Snapshot ID when above 0.
actions.search_notes.props.snapshot_id.d: The snapshot_id from a previous search, for later pages.
actions.search_notes.props.updated_after: Only include items updated at or after this time (inclusive).
actions.search_notes.props.updated_befor: Only include items updated at or before this time (inclusive).
actions.set_note_created_at.description: Backdate the visible creation time of a note without changing its content.
actions.set_note_created_at.props.create: New creation time. Must be in the past and earlier than the original creation time.
actions.set_note_created_at.props.note_i: The ID of the note to backdate. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.trash_note.description: Move a note to the trash. It can be brought back with Restore Note.
actions.trash_note.props.note_id.descrip: The ID of the note to move to the trash. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.update_collection.description: Rename a collection or change its description.
actions.update_collection.props.descript: New description. Leave empty to keep the current one.
actions.update_collection.props.title.de: New title. Leave empty to keep the current one.
actions.update_note.description: Replace the full content of a note. The first line becomes the new title.
actions.update_note.props.content.descri: The complete new Markdown body. It replaces the existing content.
actions.update_note.props.note_id.descri: The ID of the note to update. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.
actions.update_note.props.updated_at.des: Optional last-updated timestamp. Defaults to now.
actions.update_note.props.version.descri: Current note version from Get Note. Leave empty to fetch it automatically.
auth.description: Create an API key in Mem under **Settings → API** and paste it here.
description: Capture and organize your thoughts using Mem.ai
triggers.new_note.description: Triggers when a new note is created in Mem. Each poll reads every page of changes since the last poll. A note created with a past Created At (for example by Create Note) does not fire this trigger; use Updated Note to catch it.
triggers.new_note.props.collection_id.de: Only watch notes in this collection. Leave empty to watch all notes.
triggers.updated_note.description: Triggers when a note is created or updated in Mem. Each poll reads every page of changes since the last poll.
triggers.updated_note.props.collection_i: Only watch notes in this collection. Leave empty to watch all notes.
